human_contributions.description: Selected continuation of PR #1079 onto current Main as the Cloud-Transputer integration candidate.
Required that predecessor deployment evidence is not transferred and that transport success is not treated as EFFECT_ACK_DONE.

artificial_cognitive_contributions.description: Bound the shared CI, zero-bug and collective-review failure to unpersisted deterministic integrity output; bound the terminal failure to an initial health/readback race without asserting an unobserved process-exit cause.

Integrated current Main append-only, restored a standalone-neutral terminal start surface, retained explicit Cloud/Compose Mesh routing, aligned the runtime contract at V2, made the container contract require three consecutive full Health-plus-capability readback pairs with bounded observation and socket evidence, labelled every post-readback check in the runtime artifact, and scoped Firefox ESR's unsigned local-reference-XPI setting to the CI reference container only.
Added deterministic CLI daemon liveness coverage and source-bound terminal regression checks before fresh exact-head CI.
